reason: Savers is a for-profit thrift retailer selling donated secondhand goods to value-seeking shoppers. Upbound is a lease-to-own and fintech business. It leases new durable goods through Rent-A-Center and Acima, and offers the Brigit app. The two share only a loose low-budget consumer angle. Their products, revenue models and sourcing differ, so they are not peers.

revenue_model.reason: Savers earns from retail sales of goods. Upbound earns mainly from lease payments, with an option to purchase.

value_chain_position.reason: Both reach consumers, but Savers is a thrift retailer and Upbound is a lessor and financing intermediary.
